title: Item:+2 Enhancement Spirit
wikitext:
[[Image:Potion Generic Enhancement Spirit.png]] {{Ingredient |icon = |pic = 2 Enhancement Spirit.jpg |type = manufactured |cost = 5 pp |weight = 0.01 |bind = {{Bind|No}} |system = cannith |dropsfrom = |createdfrom = |usedin = |maxstack = |description = Bright blue and smelling slightly of rain, this syrupy fluid seems to hum with magical energy waves. This can be applied to treasure objects in crafting recipes of the Arcane crafting school to give the items a +2 Enhancement Bonus.

This spirit can be obtained by combining any item that has a +2 Enhancement Bonus with [[Liquid Knife Potion]] in a deconstruction crafting device. |tips = }}
